conversation.content: You are a JavaScript code quality expert with expertise in procedural generation and game development. Evaluate code based on functionality, performance, best practices, and requirements fulfillment.

**Solution A**

| Criterion | Max Score | Score | Comments |
|---|---|---|---|
| Map Generation Quality (4) | 4 | 3.5 | Generates rectangular rooms with corridor connections and fairly diverse layouts (≈ 8 rooms). The use of non‑overlap checks gives realistic outlines, but the variant set is limited and the map can feel repetitive.|
| Connectivity & Features (3) | 3 | 0.5 | Implements a flood‑fill and a connectivity check, but the starting point (0,0) is almost always outside any room, so the algorithm usually fails to guarantee connectedness. Item placement uses `!visited`, forcing spawn/weapon points to be on unreachable cells. No strategic placement logic is present. |
| Performance & Interface (2) | 2 | 0.8 | The 500 × 500 canvas renders quickly enough for the demo, but the legend drawing goes out of bounds (`Y = N + 9`) and does not render cleanly. The “Generate New Map” button appears but the background highlights are unclear. |
| Code Architecture (1) | 1 | 0.8 | Functions are grouped logically and variable names are clear. The code handles most errors implicitly but lacks explicit error handling or modularization (e.g., separate generator and renderer modules). |

**Total**: **5.6 / 10**

**Solution B**

| Criterion | Max Score | Score | Comments |
|---|---|---|---|
| Map Generation Quality (4) | 4 | 0.5 | Random walk creates a single “path” area. No rooms, no interior structure; the map ends up as a single blob. Very limited realism. |
| Connectivity & Features (3) | 3 | 0.5 | Flood‑fill is performed on every floor cell but does not actually enforce map connectivity; no checks or spawn/weapon logic. |
| Performance & Interface (2) | 2 | 0.5 | Rendering loops over all cells, which is fine performance‑wise, but the “Generate New Map” button code is broken (unfinished handler), and the legend is missing. |
| Code Architecture (1) | 1 | 0.5 | Code is unstructured, contains syntax errors (unfinished `Haley(` call), and lacks comments or modular design. |

**Total**: **1.5 / 10**

---

**Verdict**

Solution A clearly outperforms Solution B in all categories, particularly in map quality and connectivity logic, despite its some interface and algorithmic shortcomings.

**MY VOTE IS FOR: A**
